answer: To resist Sybils, require each agent to earn a comet pass: a short, unpredictable challenge completed within minutes, proving real compute and attention, not a copied key. Passing mints a violet credential that cannot be transferred and decays unless the agent keeps doing peer-verified work. New identities start in a shale tier with tiny limits and graduate only after independent peers stake reputation on them; if a Sybil is caught, the fake and its vouchers lose stake. Faking thousands thus costs thousands of live passes plus lost stake, while one honest agent pays almost nothing.
